# Crypto Market Dispatch

> Independent crypto news for active traders, explaining market moves, exchange flows, protocol changes and regulation with sourced, concise reporting.

Coverage: Market Structure, Exchange Flows, Protocol Economics, Stablecoin Markets, Crypto Regulation.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/archive/): everything published.
